description_en: How long in milliseconds to wait for the helper before treating the run as failed
description_ja: ポリシーヘルパーの応答を待機する最大時間をミリ秒単位で指定し、これを超えると実行失敗として処理されます。
use_case_ja:
- ポリシーヘルパーが外部リソース等を参照する場合のタイムアウト制御に使用します。
- 親オブジェクトである policyHelper 内で定義します。設定がない場合や遅延が発生した際の起動失敗を防ぐために調整します。
parent_descriptions: Admin-deployed executable that computes managed settings dynamically at startup. Honored only from MDM or the system managed-settings.json. Requires Claude Code v2.1.136 or later. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#available-settings
doc_snippets: Key Type Description path string Absolute path to the helper executable timeoutMs number How long to wait for the helper before treating the run as failed refreshIntervalMs How often to re-run the helper in the background. Set to 0 to disable refresh, or to at least 60000 The helper writes a JSON envelope to stdout. Put the settings under a managedSettings key rather than at the top level, since a bare settings object parses with managedSettings undefined and applies nothing:
